rule: A track is omitted entirely unless explicit source evidence permits Civweave redistribution and a direct downloadable audio file is available.
storage: metadata-and-download-references-only; hubs fetch lazily and compute SHA-256 when the binary enters cache

providers.ccmixter: Query API restricted to allowlisted Creative Commons/Public Domain classes plus per-result license evidence

selection_rule: Source license and vocal metadata are checked before discovery. Genre and vocal tags are signals, not listening or lyric audits. Only hand-seeded recordings were manually reviewed; other recordings remain unreviewed candidates and are excluded from S.A.F.E. playback.
